heading: Parables of the Quran
summary: Parables of the Quran brings together fourteen Quranic parables with their full verses, a three-part visual breakdown of the imagery, classical commentary notes, and a reflection question. Read the passage first, use the diagram to trace the comparison, and return to the text with fresh eyes.
steps: Choose a parable or use the filters to find one.
Read the full selected passage and its attributed explanation before exploring the diagram.
Use the reflection question as a prompt, then revisit the cited text and its context.

questions.question: Are the diagrams an additional source text?
questions.answer: No. They are editorial visual aids. The Quran quotation and attributed explanation have separate source references so you can distinguish the reading from the way it is illustrated.

questions.question: Are my written reflections automatically saved?
questions.answer: Reflection notes remain in memory until you explicitly copy or download them. Do not rely on a page remaining open as permanent storage for a note.

related.name: Is It in the Quran?
related.description: Look for wording in a local Quran translation and inspect the matching passages.
